Below is a quick‑start guide on how to use your **`delta_key`** to pull the latest comments for the domain **`apple.com`**. (Assuming you’re working with the “Comments API” that supports delta‑sync.) --- ## 1. What is a `delta_key`? A `delta_key` is a cursor that tells the API where you left off in the last sync. - **First call**: you send `delta_key=null` (or omit it) to get the full set of comments. - **Subsequent calls**: you send the `delta_key` returned from the previous response to fetch only the changes (new, updated, or deleted comments). --- ## 2. Endpoint & Parameters | Item | Description | |------|-------------| | **URL** | `https://api.example.com/v1/comments` | | **Method** | `GET` | | **Headers** | `Authorization: Bearer ` | | **Query Params** | `domain=apple.com`
`delta_key=`
`limit=100` (optional) | > **Tip:** If you’re using a library (e.g., `requests` in Python), you can pass the query params as a dictionary. --- ## 3. Example Requests ### 3.1 First Sync (no delta_key) ```http GET https://api.example.com/v1/comments?domain=apple.com&limit=100 Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN ``` **Response (JSON)** ```json { "comments": [ { "id": "c123", "text": "Great product!", "timestamp": "2024-06-01T12:34:56Z" }, ... ], "next_delta_key": "abcd1234efgh5678" } ``` > Save the `next_delta_key` value (`abcd1234efgh5678`) for the next call. ### 3.2 Subsequent Sync (using delta_key) ```http GET https://api.example.com/v1/comments?domain=apple.com&delta_key=abcd1234efgh5678&limit=100 Authorization: Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN ``` **Response (JSON)** ```json { "comments": [ { "id": "c124", "text": "Loved the new design.", "timestamp": "2024-06-02T08:15:00Z" }, { "id": "c123", "text": "Great product! (edited)", "timestamp": "2024-06-02T09:00:00Z" } ], "next_delta_key": "ijkl9012mnop3456" } ``` > Update your stored `delta_key` to the new value (`ijkl9012mnop3456`). --- ## 4. Handling Pagination If the API returns more than `limit` comments, it will include a `next_delta_key`. Keep calling the endpoint with the new `delta_key` until the response contains no `next_delta_key` (or until you hit your desired page count). --- ## 5. Error Handling | HTTP Status | Meaning | Typical Fix | |-------------|---------|-------------| | `401 Unauthorized` | Invalid or expired token | Refresh your access token | | `400 Bad Request` | Malformed query (e.g., wrong domain format) | Verify `domain` and `delta_key` values | | `429 Too Many Requests` | Rate limit exceeded | Back off and retry after the `Retry-After` header | --- ## 6. Sample Code Snippets ### Python (requests) ```python import requests BASE_URL = "https://api.example.com/v1/comments" TOKEN = "YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN" DOMAIN = "apple.com" def fetch_comments(delta_key=None): headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {TOKEN}"} params = {"domain": DOMAIN, "limit": 100} if delta_key: params["delta_key"] = delta_key resp = requests.get(BASE_URL, headers=headers, params=params) resp.raise_for_status() data = resp.json() return data["comments"], data.get("next_delta_key") # First sync comments, next_key = fetch_comments() print(f"Fetched {len(comments)} comments. Next delta_key: {next_key}") # Subsequent sync if next_key: comments, next_key = fetch_comments(next_key) print(f"Fetched {len(comments)} new/updated comments. Next delta_key: {next_key}") ``` ### JavaScript (fetch) ```js const BASE_URL = "https://api.example.com/v1/comments"; const TOKEN = "YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN"; const DOMAIN = "apple.com"; async function fetchComments(deltaKey = null) { const params = new URLSearchParams({ domain: DOMAIN, limit: 100 }); if (deltaKey) params.append("delta_key", deltaKey); const res = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}?${params.toString()}`, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` }, }); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status}`); const data = await res.json(); return { comments: data.comments, nextDeltaKey: data.next_delta_key }; } // Usage (async () => { let { comments, nextDeltaKey } = await fetchComments(); console.log(`Fetched ${comments.length} comments. Next delta_key: ${nextDeltaKey}`); if (nextDeltaKey) { const result = await fetchComments(nextDeltaKey); console.log(`Fetched ${result.comments.length} new/updated comments. Next delta_key: ${result.nextDeltaKey}`); } })(); ``` --- ## 7. Quick Checklist 1. **Get an access token** – ensure it’s valid and has the `comments.read` scope. 2. **Set `domain=apple.com`** – the API expects the domain exactly as shown. 3. **Use the `delta_key` from the previous response** – do not modify it. 4. **Handle pagination** – keep fetching until no `next_delta_key` is returned. 5. **Store the latest `delta_key`** – this is your cursor for the next sync. --- ### Final Note If you run into any issues (e.g., unexpected fields, missing `next_delta_key`), double‑check the API documentation for the exact field names and any version‑specific quirks. Happy syncing!
